name: glycol_runaround_recovery_loop
title: Air-to-air glycol run-around heat-recovery loop
summary: Run-around heat recovery between the extracted and the fresh air of an air handling unit: two epsilon-NTU coils under Braun's hypothesis (dry and wet regimes computed simultaneously, the regime of largest capacity kept), linked by a glycol loop with Colebrook piping pressure drop and a pump; glycol properties from the ULiège BrineProp library.

origin.course: ULiège model bank, air-to-air glycol recovery loop, 2008-01-10 (references Braun et al. 1989 and Ding et al. 1990)

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (144 decoded variables) against the runnable variant glycol_runaround_recovery_loop_coolsolve.eescode - pointwise only: at the stored point all equations of the model are satisfied (largest residual 57 J/kg on the humid-air enthalpy h_cooling_c_wet, 0.22 %, EES vs CoolProp humid-air formulation; all others <= 0.04), but the variant does not converge in CoolSolve (CS-BUG-NEWTON-CYCLE), so no .sol and no compare_solution.py run yet
verification.notes: Native file blocked by CS-GAP-IF-DIRECTIVE (both $IF regime branches kept: 169 equations / 144 unknowns), CS-GAP-IF5, CS-GAP-CALL-EXPR-OUT and CS-GAP-INCLUDE (BrineProp USERLIB). The winter-resolved variant is square (271 equations, largest block 65) and stops on the solver bug CS-BUG-NEWTON-CYCLE; a T-RECHECK after that bug should solve it, verify against the stored solution and commit the .sol.
